_doc: Tamil Music Composer Agent — Song Specification Format

metadata._doc_title_en: Song title in English/romanised form. REQUIRED (at least one of title_en or title_ta).
metadata._doc_title_ta: Song title in Tamil script. REQUIRED (at least one of title_en or title_ta).
metadata._doc_language: ISO 639-1 language code for vocals. ACE-Step supports: ar, az, bg, bn, ca, cs, da, de, el, en, es, fa, fi, fr, he, hi, hr, ht, hu, id, is, it, ja, ko, la, lt, ms, ne, nl, no, pa, pl, pt, ro, ru, sa, sk, sr, sv, sw, ta, te, th, tl, tr, uk, ur, vi, yue, zh, unknown. Default: 'unknown'.
metadata._doc_disclosure: AI generation disclosure text for metadata/YouTube descriptions.

music._doc_genre: Free-text genre description. Examples: 'melodic ballad', 'upbeat pop', 'kuthu dance', 'carnatic fusion', 'hip hop', 'rock anthem', 'jazz', 'EDM', 'folk', 'devotional', 'classical'. Gets inserted into the ACE-Step caption.
music._doc_mood: Array of mood descriptors. Examples: 'romantic', 'tender', 'energetic', 'melancholic', 'joyful', 'dark', 'uplifting', 'intense', 'calm', 'nostalgic', 'devotional', 'playful'. Joined with 'and' in the caption.
music._doc_bpm: Beats per minute. Range: 30–300. Common ranges: ballad 60–80, pop 100–130, dance 120–150, kuthu 130–160. Set null for auto-detection by the LLM.
music._doc_key: Musical key. Format: note + quality. Notes: A, B, C, D, E, F, G (with optional # or b). Qualities: 'major', 'minor'. Examples: 'C major', 'A minor', 'Bb major', 'F# minor'. Leave empty for auto-detection.
music._doc_time_signature: Time signature numerator as string. '2' = 2/4, '3' = 3/4, '4' = 4/4 (most common), '6' = 6/8. Leave empty for auto-detection.
music._doc_instruments: Array of instrument names. Examples: 'acoustic guitar', 'electric guitar', 'piano', 'synthesizer', 'strings', 'violin', 'flute', 'veena', 'mridangam', 'tabla', 'sitar', 'drums', 'bass guitar', 'trumpet', 'saxophone', 'harmonium'. These appear in the ACE-Step caption.
music._doc_orchestration: Orchestration density hint. Examples: 'soft', 'minimal', 'lush', 'full', 'sparse', 'heavy', 'delicate'. Prefixed to the instruments list in the caption.
music._doc_vocal_style: Vocal description. Free text. Examples: 'male, emotional, clear', 'female, powerful, high-pitched', 'male and female duet, harmonious', 'raspy male vocals', 'soft female soprano'. For duets, describe both voices.
music._doc_reference_style: Reference style/influence description. Free text. Examples: 'cinematic Indian film music, lullaby feel', 'A.R. Rahman style orchestration', '90s Tamil film music', 'Ilaiyaraaja classical fusion', 'Bollywood dance number'. Appended to caption.
music.reference_style: cinematic Indian film music, lullaby feel

lyrics._doc_use_tamil_script: If true, send lines_ta to ACE-Step; if false, send lines_en. Falls back to the other if the chosen one is empty.
lyrics._doc_sections: Array of lyric sections. Each section has a tag, and lines in English transliteration and/or Tamil script.

sections._doc_tag: Section label. Common tags: 'Intro', 'Verse 1', 'Verse 2', 'Pre-Chorus', 'Chorus', 'Bridge', 'Outro', 'Interlude', 'Hook', 'Rap'. ACE-Step uses these as [Tag] headers.
sections._doc_voice: Optional. For duets, specify which voice sings this section: 'male', 'female', 'both', or omit for default. Used in caption building for duet songs.
sections._doc_lines_en: Lyric lines in English/romanised Tamil. Markers: '~' (tilde) binds words as one phrase (stripped to space for ACE-Step), '|' (pipe) marks syllable breaks (stripped entirely for ACE-Step). Both are preserved in annotated lyrics for LRC post-processing.
sections._doc_lines_ta: Same lines in Tamil script. Markers same as lines_en.

lines_ta: என் உயிரா நீ என் உயிரே நீ

generation._doc_duration: Target audio length in seconds. Range: 10–600. Typical: 120 (2min), 180 (3min), 240 (4min). Default: 120.
generation._doc_batch_size: Number of variations to generate. Each gets a different seed. Range: 1–8. Default: 1.
generation._doc_inference_steps: Diffusion steps. 8 = turbo (fast, good quality). 32–100 = base model (slower, potentially higher quality). Default: 8.
generation._doc_guidance_scale: Classifier-free guidance strength. Higher = stricter prompt adherence. Range: 1.0–15.0. 7.0 is a good default. Only applies to non-turbo model. Default: 7.0.
generation._doc_mp3_bitrate: MP3 bitrate (only when audio_format='mp3'). Options: '128k', '192k', '256k', '320k'. Default: '192k'.
generation._doc_seed: Random seed for reproducibility. -1 = random each time. Any positive integer = deterministic. Default: -1.
generation._doc_fade_out_duration: Fade-out at end of audio in seconds. 0 = no fade. Default: 2.0.
generation._doc_thinking: Enable 5Hz LLM chain-of-thought reasoning for music metadata and audio codes. true = better quality (uses LLM). false = faster (DiT-only). Default: true.

output._doc_song_id: Unique identifier for this song. Used as the output subdirectory name. Default: 'song-00001'.
output._doc_output_dir: Base output directory (relative to ace-step-1.5 root, or absolute). Default: 'output/tamil_songs'.
